title: a verdict run on Windows re-runs its instrument under a confirmed seal, so a Windows clause is judged by the gate and not only by the builder
intention: On a box without bubblewrap, the verdict gate asks the sealer for its instrument run and reads the sealer's outcome, instead of refusing with exit 2, so a clause is judged by the sealer and the builder's own validate run is never the only measurement.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendell: `sail.py verdict 35bb99574043` and `sail.py verdict 1eeeab70c59e` were each refused by the gate because its re-run of `bin/cairn test <proof>` exited 2 with: cairn test --exec: refused — the instance seal is not confirmed (indeterminate: cannot build the instance seal: bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed); the command was not run. Windows has no seal, so the gate can never confirm a green-on-Windows clause itself; it is measured only by the builder's own validate run (Law 3). The earlier instance 3a38e2e1cfe0 got around it by verdicting its Windows clause on Linux (berth verdict-20261113T024209, PROVED 11-13). Outline 9.4.8.1 already settles the design (open-c5b4c7304e85, answered from the outline): the verdict's instrument run is seal-grade and runs where the sealer runs; a box without bubblewrap asks for it and does not run it itself; a bwrap-only tooth reads not-run there, never red. Measured 2026-11-19 on main c18939ee6: verdict.py runs the instrument as a fork through `bin/cairn test --exec` and records a refused seal as seal_refused (verdict.py lines 236-268, header line 147 'A run is a fork. It is never an ask'); no hand-off to the sealer exists in verdict.py or sail.verdict, so the Windows verdict can only refuse. Related: 56b61c10bdbe builds the Windows seal, which is a different route and is not what 9.4.8.1 asks.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a Windows green measured by the builder alone is a claim); Law 8 (prove, then trust: the verdict is the peer's check that the hand did not write); Law 7 (the refusal is loud and stays a refusal).
how: A hypothesis, measured by clauses 1 and 2: when the instrument's sealed exec comes back seal_refused (no bubblewrap), the gate sends the run to the sealer as a CLIENT DIAL to a configured sealer address: the bus as built (ticket 5183005fa134, cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, `host:port` over pinned mutual TLS, the way akienasus already reaches the Dell), asking the tester's `exec` verb (ticket 21f9628872da), and reads the sealer's outcome as the verdict's outcome; the box's own run is never recorded as a pass or a red. The gate takes the sealer through a `sealer` callable seam on observe_instruments so a proof drives it without a network. BUILDME waits on 21f9628872da PROVED (the tester answers an exec ask). BUILDME waits on akiendell pinned to the sealer's bus (the operator's fingerprint check at cairn install). Red-first proof under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared. No exemption: with no sealer reachable the gate refuses, loud and recorded.

clauses.claim: on a box without bubblewrap, a verdict whose instrument run is seal_refused sends the run to the sealer and replies naming the ask, where today it is refused with exit 2 and the instance-seal line
the sealer's outcome (pass or fail, with its evidence) becomes the verdict's outcome for that instrument
a bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box and never red, and the box's own run is never recorded as a pass
with no sealer reachable the gate still refuses, loud and recorded, naming the seal line, and writes no pass

decisions.text: D1: when the sealed exec returns seal_refused, the verdict gate dials the configured sealer address and asks the tester's `exec` verb (ticket 21f9628872da), reading its record as the outcome; the verb is named here, not invented in the gate. BUILDME waits on 21f9628872da PROVED and on akiendell pinned to the Dell.
D2: the red-first proof drives the gate with a fake seal_refused run and a fake sealer reply, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.

out: cairn/devices/tester (the exec verb is 21f9628872da; the Windows seal is 56b61c10bdbe)
federated bus routing between boxes (outline 5.5.3.8): a separate, bigger intention, not cast here
pinning akiendell to the Dell (cairn install on both boxes, an operator step)
